observations: Silver electronic keyboard wrapped in clear plastic film.
Brand 'YAMAHA' is visible on the control panel in photo 0.
The keyboard has 61 keys (37 white, 24 black).
A built-in cassette player is visible in the center of the panel.
The unit is standing vertically on a tiled floor.
A watermark 'MARY OLUGBAMI POSTED ON JIJI' is present on both photos.

claims.evidence: The item is shown in a UK-style setting, but 'used' and 'quality' cannot be verified from photos.
Sound quality cannot be assessed through still images.

claims.claim: All keys and buttons working, adapter included. Bought from the UK, no dead key, no crackle.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The keyboard may not power on or produce sound.
risks.proof: A video of the keyboard being played or a screenshot of the display showing active sound.

risks.risk: The internal battery may be dead or the power adapter may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the power adapter and a video showing the unit powered on.

risks.risk: The built-in cassette player may be non-functional.
risks.proof: A video of the cassette player playing a song.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken cassette player

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the keyboard powered on and playing a song.
Photo of the model number sticker on the back or side of the unit.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
